description:
[read-only] Searches the brand's selected ad account for targeting ids by name: q (2+ characters), dimension (default interest; also behavior, demographic, geo with geoType and countryCode), limit. Returns { results: [{ id, name, path?, audienceSize? }] }; put the ids in targeting.interests of ads_campaign_create. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/targeting/search.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_targeting_search
title: Search ad targeting (interests)
